name: Metamagic Rod, Intensified
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser intensified metamagic rod 3,000 gp
Intensified metamagic rod 11,000 gp
Greater intensified metamagic rod 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are intensified as though using the Intensified Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Intensified Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser intensified metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Intensified metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater intensified metamagic rod 12,250 gp
